data.name: Sweet Swipe
data.detailed_description:
🎵 Music and Freedom – Live the dream, fight for justice!

When Daniel is wrongfully arrested, young Tadeu must use his parkour skills to race against time, explore the city, and prove his brother’s innocence. Dive into an emotional story about dreams, family, and resilience as you follow the path that could change their lives forever.

Sweet Swipe Niterói is a 2D platform game focused on action and exploration, inspired by real-life scenarios from the city of Niterói, RJ, Brazil. You play as Tadeu, a young man determined to prove the innocence of his older brother, Daniel, who was wrongly imprisoned. Using parkour-based movements, you will run, jump and climb through the city while gathering clues and advancing the story..

Main features::

  • Fluid platforming Run
    Jump and slide through levels designed with mobility in mind. The movement system is easy to learn on PC using the AWSD or arrow keys.

  • Scenarios inspired by real locations
    Explore different neighborhoods in Niterói, each with unique settings, varied obstacles and a beautiful landscape.

  • Story based on justice and overcoming
    Advance through a narrative centered on themes of social injustice, with an initial dialogue that reveals the motivation that awakened in Tadeu the need to run, jumping over various obstacles.

  • Exploration and precision challenges
    Overcome obstacles that require attention, reflexes and precision. Each level brings new types of challenges that test your skills.

  • Hand-drawn aesthetics
    2D graphics with hand-drawn art, capturing the colors and urban atmosphere of a Brazilian city.

  • Original soundtrack
    Music composed especially for the game, with influences from Brazilian urban music that accompanies the game's ambiance and development.

  • Keyboard and gamepad support. Gameplay compatible with standard PC controllers
    Sweet Swipe Niterói offers a short, single-player experience, ideal for those who enjoy platform games with narrative, motivating soundtracks, and urban challenges. It does not contain user-generated content, nor online or multiplayer features.

  • Who is the game for?

Sweet Swipe Niterói is ideal for players who enjoy:

  • Platform games

  • Short but impactful narratives

  • Hand-drawn aesthetics and Brazilian visual identity

  • Urban experiences with social elements

data.short_description: Run, jump and slide with style in Sweet Swipe! An exciting 2D platformer with simple controls, parkour-inspired movements, hand-drawn street art, an original soundtrack and a vibrant story of courage, resilience and justice.

Portuguese - Brazil*, Portuguese - Portugal*, English*, French*, Italian*, Spanish - Spain*, Spanish - Latin America*, Japanese*, Russian*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+ or superior, Windows 10 ou macOS 10.12+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalente
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Suporte a DX10 (shader model 4.0)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
